definitions.explanation: The bone extending from the shoulder to the base of the neck.

examples.japanese: {鎖骨|さこつ}を{骨折|こっせつ}した。
{鎖骨|さこつ}が{きれい|きれい}に{見|み}える{服|ふく}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose clothes that show off my collarbones nicely.

examples.japanese: {痩|や}せていて{鎖骨|さこつ}が{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: I'm thin and my collarbones are prominent.

notes:
ANATOMY:
The collarbone connects the shoulder blade ({肩甲骨|けんこうこつ}) to the breastbone ({胸骨|きょうこつ}). It is one of the most commonly fractured bones.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, visible collarbones are sometimes considered attractive, and clothing that reveals them is popular.
